featured_reviews.name: Pius Lopes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Church of St. Roque
Erected in 1943 (ref: Catholic Diocese of Vasai)

History can safely record that this parish was founded as a result of a promise made to St. Roque by the people of Gokhivare. In 1914 the village was severely affected by an epidemic of cholera. The Catholics made a vow to build a chapel in honor of St. Roque.
Two hundred villagers kept their promise and built a 40’ by 18’ structure to which the Archibishop Lima added a 18’ by 15 Sancury. On June 30, 1930, the Dean of South Bassein blessed the chapel, which was still under the jurisdiction of St, Michael's, Manickpur.
Gokhivare got its independent parish in 1943 with Father Nubiola S. J as the first parish priest. The parish stayed under the care of the Jesuits, except for the brief period between 1968-71 when Fr. Servulo Vaz, a secular priest was the Vicar.
In 1990 the church was extended on the Northern side. However with large migration of Catholics of Mumbai to Vasai, this parish has been completely demolished and built again into a massive structure from scratch.

Gokhivare, Vasai Rd. (E), Dist Thane 401 208

featured_reviews.review_text: I was undergoing a very challenging situation in life in 2011. My train friend, who knew of this church, suggested that I drop in. This is because pastor and his wife are truly in the Lord and give each and every believer personal attention. Certain churches had previously disappointed me as the pastors led lives very different from what they preached. In practical matters as well, the church has immensely helped me. There’s unity among the church goers. A wide range of topics are Biblically covered at church. The fill in the gaps method of various Biblical lessons, help us easily to remember and translate to our lives the content of what is taught.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Thanks to St. Joseph church
I am relative of Father Wilson .I went there from pune for funeral of Father Wilson Gaikwad. The whole church members of St Joseph church treated us very good. Take care of us. Church youth is very humble and good I am really impressed.they arranged all things very nicely.
All the father's talked with us very nicely and comforted us.
After funeral Some members arranged nice snacks for all of us.and food also.
I am really blessed.
All of you gave us memory that will now last for lifetime.
we will never forget all of you.
God bless father who taking care of church,God bless all commitee members,
God bless all youth, all the members,
God bless You all...
